questions.stem: What can be inferred from the fact that most people in the world knew almost nothing about Chinese life when Buck wrote her first books?
options: Most readers already knew a great deal about Chinese culture before her books were published.
Her novels likely served as an important introduction to Chinese life for many readers who knew little about it.
Her books had no impact on readers' understanding of China.
Buck wrote exclusively for a Chinese audience.
questions.evidence: Pearl Buck wrote her first books about China at a time when most people in the world knew almost nothing about the Chinese way of life.
questions.explanation_ko: 당시 대부분의 사람들이 중국인의 생활 방식을 거의 몰랐다는 내용에서, 그의 소설이 많은 독자에게 중국 생활을 소개하는 중요한 역할을 했을 것이라고 추론할 수 있습니다.

questions.stem: Why does the author describe Pearl Buck's early life living among poor villagers in northern China with her husband?
options: To explain the source of the subject matter for many of her later books
To criticize her husband's agricultural work
To argue that she should have stayed in the United States
To describe how she learned to write poetry
questions.evidence: Their life among the poorest people provided the subject matter for many of the books she later wrote.
questions.explanation_ko: 이 설명은 그가 나중에 쓴 여러 책의 소재가 어디서 비롯되었는지를 보여 주기 위한 것입니다.

key_points: Pearl S. Buck, who grew up in China as the child of American religious workers, became the first American woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1938, after winning the Pulitzer Prize for The Good Earth in 1932.
She wrote more than 100 books, but is best remembered for her novels about China, informed by nearly 40 years living there, including years in a poor northern Chinese village with her first husband.
The Good Earth tells the story of a poor Chinese farmer, Wang Lung, and his wife O-Lan, who work hard to buy land and improve their lives, though their good fortune does not last.

After returning to the United States, Buck bought a farm in Pennsylvania, wrote articles on topics like war, politics, and equal rights, and gave speeches encouraging young people to value education and global understanding.
main_idea: Pearl S. Buck drew on her nearly 40 years living in China to become an award-winning author, introducing many readers around the world to Chinese life through novels like The Good Earth.
restate_sentence: But most people remember Pearl Buck for her novels about China.
